evidence.section: Splunk has removed support for versions 1.0 and 1.1 of the Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol
evidence.statement: Heavy Forwarder uses the customer-managed Enterprise package. The 10.6 upgrade notice says the temporary TLS 1.0/1.1 option was removed. The separate 10.6 configuration guide still documents the opt-in. Retain the published conflict and validate TLS 1.2 or 1.3 before upgrading. Do not rely on the legacy setting or infer UF, Cloud-managed or app-owned runtime applicability.

products: Splunk Enterprise and applicable Heavy Forwarder
exclusions: Actual package behavior and broader product or authorization scope remain unverified.

scopeComparison: Both versioned 10.6 guides cover customer-managed Enterprise inter-component TLS. The upgrade notice removes the earlier switch, while the configuration page still includes it in its table and procedure.

impact.customerScenario: Planning an Enterprise or Heavy Forwarder upgrade that still has inter-component TLS 1.0/1.1 dependencies.
impact.consequence: Depending on the old setting can leave a forwarding connection unable to negotiate.

confidence.rationale: Both official sections were directly inspected. Actual version-specific package behavior was outside the source assessment.
